purpose: Date-stamped registry mapping each substrate landing to the claims that mechanistically depend on it, so the architecture-epoch stale-evidence cross-reference (does pre-landing evidence still weight a dependent claim?) can be automated on each governance run. Populated initially from the 2026-06-02 scoped review (evidence/planning/epoch_stale_evidence_review_2026-06-02.md); extend on each substrate landing via the /implement-substrate + /governance evidence-staleness audit step.
how_to_use: For each landing: list any experimental scoring entry on a dependent claim whose timestamp_utc predates landed_utc as candidate-stale. Decide per-entry: REVALIDATE (queue EXQ) / MARK (set pending_retest_after_substrate:true on the nested runs/<run_id>/manifest.json -- NOT the flat file) / KEEP (weak/orthogonal dependence). The indexer (build_experiment_indexes.py) honors pending_retest_after_substrate + superseded_by_substrate on the NESTED manifest only, tagging scoring_excluded='stale_substrate'.
